mistakes_closed: the 2026-09-08, 09-09 and 09-10 pages each recorded that an all-cash decision wrote nothing while paper decide printed 'this is logged and will be graded'. Fixed in code; tonight's decision wrote one target and one prediction, verified against the stores.
lessons: A cap that is never breached still decides: the only name worth a thesis was unaffordable before any rule was consulted, and a book that records only breaches would show no constraint at work.
An instrument's price and its evidence can move in opposite directions for days; treating the price as a reason to go looking is sound, treating the absence of evidence as a reason to act is not.
A system that cannot record 'nothing' cannot be graded on restraint.
